recommendations.name: Regular Daily Routine
recommendations.description: Establish consistent wake-sleep times with regular meal schedules to ground vata energy

recommendations.name: Warm Oil Massage
recommendations.description: Daily self-massage with warm sesame oil to nourish dry skin and calm nervous system

recommendations.name: Warm Cooked Foods
recommendations.description: Prefer warm, moist, grounding foods like soups, stews, and cooked grains over raw cold foods

recommendations.name: Gentle Yoga & Pranayama
recommendations.description: Practice grounding yoga poses and deep breathing exercises to calm restless mind

recommendations.name: Cooling Foods
recommendations.description: Emphasize sweet, bitter, astringent tastes with cooling foods like cucumber, coconut, and leafy greens

recommendations.name: Moderate Exercise
recommendations.description: Engage in moderate exercise during cooler hours avoiding overheating and excessive competition

recommendations.name: Stress Management
recommendations.description: Practice calming activities like meditation, nature walks, and avoiding excessive heat or conflict

recommendations.name: Light Foods
recommendations.description: Choose light, warming, spicy foods and minimize heavy, oily, sweet, and cold foods

recommendations.name: Vigorous Exercise
recommendations.description: Engage in stimulating, energetic exercise daily to counter lethargy and promote circulation

recommendations.name: Wake Early
recommendations.description: Wake before sunrise (around 5-6 AM) to align with natural kapha-reducing rhythms
